summary: Device interaction logging records commands and responses, including possible plain-text passwords, so it's off by default and warns per task. Enable per task with ansible_persistent_log_messages, or globally with log_messages in [persistent_connection].
questions: How do I log the commands sent to a network device?
How do I enable log_messages for one task only?

answer_card.title: Enable device interaction logging
answer_card.answer_md:
**Security warning:** logs commands and responses, which may include plain-text passwords. Off by default; when on, every task warns about it.

Set `ANSIBLE_LOG_PATH`, then either per task:
```yaml
- cisco.ios.ios_command:
    commands: [show version]
  vars:
    ansible_persistent_log_messages: True
```
or globally in `ansible.cfg`:
```ini
[persistent_connection]
log_messages = True
```
or `ANSIBLE_PERSISTENT_LOG_MESSAGES=True`.
